summary: Exactly one bounded MZ73 fallback prediction job, Slurm 1325, was submitted for the frozen 18-structure request. It uses MatRIS as primary and AQCat25 as an exact-structure external auditor; no VASP or training job was submitted.

payload.objective: Complete and assess the geometry-qualified MatRIS/AQCat25 fallback prediction round for the Fe(110) C2HO* + H* -> C2H2O* path before preparing any VASP labels.
current_evidence: MZ73 Slurm job 1325 was submitted once for request SHA-256 f01b10a39c5af586bb8db7d43643313527039d48afbf0fabe61421a11fe02fdb and was observed RUNNING on MZ73 four seconds after submission.
The request contains 18 frozen, geometry-qualified structures, including the distinct pre_12 last-valid and fail_12 first-failure boundary structures.

The bound MatRIS checkpoint SHA-256 is 1e6a85b33db075ad1637eca7537084024a694b1340358911212d8a5c518c6601 and the AQCat25 audit checkpoint SHA-256 is e1f14d50590102dbdf64491a6ae328df6ba0ca2ebb947fbe72213820ae67eb50.
This is prediction-only fallback execution. A single MatRIS checkpoint plus AQCat25 audit does not constitute a MatRIS committee and cannot support a quantitative uncertainty claim.
No VASP label, MatRIS fine-tuning, full-path rerun, micro-NEB, or Dimer job was submitted.
payload.one_executable_step: Monitor job 1325 to a terminal state. If it completes normally, collect and hash the exact 18-structure predictions and producer exit record, validate completeness, then automatically score, cluster, and select at most seven structures including the pre_12/fail_12 boundary pair and prepare but do not submit the compatible VASP label batch.
payload.submission_boundary: The exact one-job GPU authorization has been consumed. Do not duplicate or retry job 1325 automatically. Collection, validation, scoring, clustering, and local VASP-package preparation are allowed; VASP labels, fine-tuning, path rerun, micro-NEB, and Dimer still require separate hash-bound authorization.
done_when: Exact MatRIS and AQCat25 predictions are collected and validated for all 18 frozen structures.
At most seven informative structures are clustered and selected with the pre_12/fail_12 boundary pair preserved.
A compatible SIGMA=0.20 eV NSW=0 VASP force-label batch is prepared for review but remains unsubmitted.
